# imeihub — Complete Machine-Readable Reference (llms-full.txt)

> imeihub (https://imeihub.net) is a fast, server-rendered IMEI lookup and mobile device verification platform offering free unlimited GSMA TAC brand/model checks and 43+ pay-per-check premium reports (Apple iCloud, Carrier, MDM, Warranty, Full GSX, Worldwide Blacklist, Samsung Knox, Xiaomi, Huawei, Google Pixel, US Carriers) via a prepaid Credit Wallet with an Automatic Refund Guarantee.

Last Updated: 2026-11-22
Support Email: support@imeihub.net
Website: https://imeihub.net
Sitemap: https://imeihub.net/sitemap.xml
RSS Feed: https://imeihub.net/rss.xml

## 1. Complete Service Catalog & Transparent Pricing (USD, as of November 2026)

### Free Lookup
- **Free IMEI Check (`IMEI_BASIC`) — $0.00 (Free):** Instant TAC-based manufacturer, model name, and basic hardware specs. No sign-in, no CAPTCHA, no credit card.

### Apple Checks — Featured
- **Basic Info (`APPLE_BASIC`) — $0.10:** Exact iPhone/iPad model, description, refurb/demo/replacement flags, Find My iPhone, iCloud, Blacklist, warranty, purchase date, SIM-Lock.
- **Carrier (Lite) (`APPLE_CARRIER_LITE`) — $0.08:** Model, purchase date, country, Next Activation Policy ID/name, SIM-Lock.
- **Carrier (Pro) (`APPLE_CARRIER_PRO`) — $0.16:** Full activation status, AppleCare eligibility, coverage expiration, FMI, iCloud, Blacklist, Next Activation Policy, SIM-Lock.
- **Carrier (Pro Plus) (`APPLE_CARRIER_PRO_PLUS`) — $0.26:** Carrier Pro plus Open Repair Case and Part Number / MPN.
- **Max Info (Premium) (`APPLE_MAX_INFO`) — $0.70:** Carrier Pro Plus with MDM Status and full Blacklist details (country, carrier, date, reason).

### Apple Checks — iCloud & Activation Lock
- **iCloud (ON / OFF) (`APPLE_ICLOUD_STATUS`) — $0.01:** Fast Find My iPhone Activation Lock ON/OFF check.
- **iCloud (Clean / Lost) (`APPLE_ICLOUD_CLEAN`) — $0.03:** Activation Lock plus Clean vs. Lost/Erased mode.
- **iCloud (Clean / Lost) SN (`APPLE_ICLOUD_CLEAN_SN`) — $0.10:** Serial-number-based Clean/Lost check.
- **iCloud ID Hint (`APPLE_ICLOUD_ID_HINT`) — $0.80:** Masked Apple ID email hint.
- **iCloud MacBook/iMac (ON / OFF) (`APPLE_MAC_ICLOUD_STATUS`) — $0.30:** Find My Mac ON/OFF check.
- **iCloud MacBook/iMac (Clean / Lost) (`APPLE_MAC_ICLOUD_CLEAN`) — $0.40:** Find My Mac Clean/Lost check.

### Apple Checks — MDM & Supervision
- **MDM (ON / OFF) (`APPLE_MDM`) — $0.35:** Corporate/school Mobile Device Management enrollment check by IMEI.
- **MDM (ON / OFF) SN (`APPLE_MDM_SN`) — $0.30:** MDM check by Serial Number.
- **MDM + FMI (ON / OFF) (`APPLE_MDM_FMI`) — $0.50:** Combined MDM supervision and Find My status.

### Apple Checks — Device & Warranty Info
- **Warranty & Activation Info (`APPLE_WARRANTY`) — $0.04:** Activation status, coverage end date, AppleCare eligibility, estimated purchase date.
- **Warranty & Activation Info SN (`APPLE_WARRANTY_SN`) — $0.05:** Serial-number warranty lookup.
- **Part Number / MPN (`APPLE_PART_NUMBER`) — $0.14:** Official Apple MPN/part number.
- **SIM-Lock Status (`APPLE_SIM_LOCK`) — $0.05:** Fast locked vs. unlocked carrier check.
- **GSX Next Tether Policy (`APPLE_GSX_TETHER`) — $0.20:** Next tether activation policy details.

### Apple Checks — GSX History (Premium)
- **GSX Light (`APPLE_GSX_LIGHT`) — $1.00:** Sold By, Case History, Replacement, GSX Activation Policy.
- **Case & Repair History (`APPLE_CASE_REPAIR_HISTORY`) — $1.20:** Apple support case and repair history.
- **Sold By & Coverage Max Info (`APPLE_SOLD_BY_COVERAGE`) — $2.00:** Original retailer/carrier and full coverage.
- **Full GSX (`APPLE_FULL_GSX`) — $2.30:** Sold By, Case History, Replacement, Activation Policy, ICCID & MAC address.
- **GSX Max Info (`APPLE_GSX_MAX`) — $2.60:** Sold By, Case, Replacement, Repair, and GSX Activation Policy.
- **Sold By & Case History (`APPLE_SOLD_BY_HISTORY`) — $4.20:** Extended GSX activation and case history.

### Worldwide Blacklist
- **WorldWide Blacklist (Simple Info) (`BLACKLIST_SIMPLE`) — $0.05:** Clean vs. Blacklisted GSMA status.
- **WorldWide Blacklist (Full Info) (`BLACKLIST_FULL`) — $0.10:** Blacklist status plus reporting carrier, country, date, and reason.

## 2. Platform Comparison: imeihub vs. Competitors

- **vs. IMEI.info:** imeihub shows exact per-check USD prices up front ($0.00–$4.20), serves clean SSR pages without aggressive WAF/CAPTCHA walls, requires no recurring subscription, and automatically refunds wallet credits if an upstream provider fails.
- **vs. iFreeiCloud.co.uk:** imeihub publishes full USD pricing publicly without requiring login, supports card (Stripe), PayPal, Binance Pay, and USDT (TRC20/BEP20) top-ups, delivers instant same-page results, and offers 130+ technical troubleshooting guides.

---

## 3. Refund Policy & Safety

- **Hardware-Only Scope:** Checking an IMEI reads only the 8-digit GSMA Type Allocation Code (TAC) and carrier/manufacturer registry flags. It cannot access personal files, photos, messages, passwords, or accounts.
- **Luhn Validation:** Every 15-digit IMEI is validated against ISO/IEC 7812-1 before any paid check is submitted.
- **Automatic Refund Guarantee:** If an upstream provider times out or returns an error, the full check fee is automatically refunded to the user's Credit Wallet. Full terms: https://imeihub.net/refund-policy

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions

- **What is an IMEI number?** The IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) is a unique 15-digit number that identifies a mobile device on cellular networks.
- **Is checking my IMEI safe?** Yes. An IMEI alone does not give anyone access to your account or data. It only identifies the hardware. Still, treat it like any other ID and avoid posting it publicly.
- **What is a TAC?** The first 8 digits of an IMEI form the Type Allocation Code (TAC), which identifies the brand and model of the device.
- **Why did my IMEI fail validation?** IMEIs must be exactly 15 digits and pass the Luhn checksum (ISO/IEC 7812).
- **How much does an IMEI check cost?** Free TAC brand/model lookups are $0.00. Paid checks start at $0.01 (iCloud ON/OFF), $0.05 (Blacklist), $0.08–$0.26 (Carrier), $0.35 (MDM), and $1.00–$4.20 (GSX).
